title: Algorithms for Linear Ordinary Differential Operators
summary: We describe an implementation in Scratchpad II of linear ordinary differential operators over a differential ring, acting on a module equipped with a compatible derivation. The abstract data type facilities of the system allow such operators to be represented and manipulated as first-class objects while retaining the usual notation for operator application.
